t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The participant basically said that there is always 2 gnomes that show up with the same colors. It is important to remember those who have the most mushrooms. It ranges from 0-9 and the gnomes are bound to change as well. If they are not doing as well then try a different gnome.

vb_textbox.text: For the game, I strongly advise for you to pay attention to the color combinations of the gnomes. I noticed that the color of the gnome determines how many mushrooms it has. In addition, I highly recommend that you pay good attention to which gnome has the most mushrooms. It is also important to remember that the gnomes can change each round and may not stay the same. So, choose wisely and feel free to always try out another gnome if something is not working for you.
